title: Aquarius Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Aquarius (January 20 – February 18) is the original air sign ruled by Uranus and Saturn. Independent, inventive and humanitarian, Aquarius thinks about the future.
personality: Aquarius marches to its own beat. Curious and inventive, they love new ideas, technology and causes that help people. They are friendly with everyone but guard their independence closely. Logical and open-minded, they can seem detached, yet they care deeply about fairness and the world.
love: Aquarius wants a partner who is also a friend and respects their freedom. Intellectual connection comes first. Give them space and they will surprise you with unusual and sincere gestures.
career: Aquarius thrives in technology, science, innovation, social causes, design and any role where they can change how things are done.
friendship: Aquarius has friends from every walk of life and treats them all as equals. They are the friend with the wildest ideas and the biggest heart for causes.

faq.q: What is the Aquarius personality like?
faq.ans: Aquarius is independent, original, open-minded and future-focused.

faq.q: Who is Aquarius most compatible with?
faq.ans: Aquarius usually matches well with Gemini, Libra and Sagittarius.

faq.q: What is the lucky stone of Aquarius?
faq.ans: Amethyst is the traditional lucky stone for Aquarius.
